crm_entity_payments.empty: No payments for this record yet: match statement lines on the dashboard or create a payment link.

crm_entity_payments.create_link_modes: Payment methods on the Modulbank page
crm_entity_payments.create_link_modes_required: Select at least one payment method.
crm_entity_payments.create_link_modes_tochka_help: The buyer opens Modulbank's secure payment page. It only shows methods enabled in your Modulbank acquiring.
crm_entity_payments.create_link_low_amount_modes: Very small amounts may hide T-Pay or Dolyame on the checkout even if enabled — try a higher amount to verify.
crm_entity_payments.create_link_modes_dropped_hint: Modulbank doesn't support some selected methods; removed: {list}.
crm_entity_payments.create_link_acquiring_required_intro: Payment links (card, SBP) work only after internet acquiring is enabled in Modulbank. Statement sync and payment matching work without acquiring.
crm_entity_payments.create_link_acquiring_required_step1: Enable internet acquiring in Modulbank: apply in online banking or through your bank manager.
crm_entity_payments.create_link_acquiring_required_step2: Open the Modulbank acquiring dashboard and find the shop's Merchant ID and secret key.
crm_entity_payments.create_link_acquiring_required_step3: In the app open Settings → Acquiring, paste the Merchant ID and secret key and click Save.
crm_entity_payments.create_link_acquiring_required_step4: Go back to the deal card and click Payment link again.
crm_entity_payments.create_link_acquiring_required_merchant: To test without charging money, enable test mode and use the test credentials from the acquiring dashboard.
crm_entity_payments.create_link_acquiring_required_support: Money from the link goes to your Modulbank account, and the app marks the payment on the deal automatically.
crm_entity_payments.create_link_purpose_hint: Insert CRM fields below or type your own text. The default line depends on the amount kind.
crm_entity_payments.create_link_purpose_pattern_deal_remaind: Additional payment under contract No. {no} of {date}
crm_entity_payments.create_link_purpose_pattern_lead_remaind: Additional payment for lead No. {no} of {date}
